title: The People of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The people of God are those whom God has redeemed, called, and set apart for Himself through Jesus Christ. They bear His name, receive His mercy, worship Him, and walk in His ways.
summary: The people of God are those whom God has redeemed, called, and set apart for Himself through Jesus Christ. They bear His name, receive His mercy, worship Him, and walk in His ways.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gathers the people of God by His blood from every tribe, language, people, and nation. In Him, those who were not a people are made God’s people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God has always purposed to have a people for Himself. Scripture speaks of a redeemed people who belong to Him, worship Him, and display His character in the world.

In Christ, God’s people are gathered by grace. They are not formed by ethnicity, social status, strength, or human worthiness, but by redemption through the blood of Jesus.

The people of God are called to holiness and witness. They proclaim the excellencies of the One who called them out of darkness into His marvelous light.

This doctrine shows that salvation is personal but never merely private. God saves people into a people who share identity, mission, worship, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Modern life often trains people to think only as isolated individuals. This doctrine reminds believers that God’s saving purpose includes a people who belong to Him together.

It also strengthens those who feel unwanted or displaced. In Christ, believers are not spiritual orphans. They are God’s own people, received by mercy and called to proclaim His glory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember that you belong to God and to His redeemed people. Live as one called out of darkness, not as one still owned by the world. Worship with God’s people, serve them, and bear witness to the mercy that made you His own.
